'''Renn Cahol''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] living on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he resided in the [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]], where he sold various [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulants]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Renn Cahol appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Stims vendor on Corellia.
